command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c 'import base64,hashlib,json,pathlib,struct,tarfile
tag="0e024f8ed-caps-musl-v1"
home=pathlib.Path.home(); p=home/("managed-resource-admission-light-"+tag)
manifest=json.loads((p/"MANIFEST.json").read_text()); assert len(manifest)==18
for e in manifest:
 assert pathlib.PurePosixPath(e["path"]).name==e["path"]
 f=p/e["path"]; assert f.is_file() and not f.is_symlink()
 b=f.read_bytes(); assert len(b)==e["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==e["sha256"]
source=json.loads((p/"source.json").read_text()); sourcepath=home/("managed-resource-admission-source-"+tag)
verified=[]
for e in source["files"]:
 if e["path"]=="Cargo.lock": continue
 b=(sourcepath/e["path"]).read_bytes()
 assert len(b)==e["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==e["sha256"]
 verified.append(e["path"])
d=source["module_derivation"]; module=(sourcepath/"crates/init/src/domains/admission.rs").read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(module[:d["production_body_bytes"]]).hexdigest()==d["production_body_sha256"]
assert module[d["production_body_bytes"]:]==d["private_suffix_utf8"].encode()
binary=json.loads((p/"binary.json").read_text()); b=pathlib.Path(binary["path"]).read_bytes()
assert len(b)==binary["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==binary["sha256"]
assert b[:6]==b"\x7fELF\x02\x01"
h=struct.unpack_from("<HHIQQQIHHHHHH",b,16)
assert h[1]==62
types=[struct.unpack_from("<I",b,h[4]+i*h[8])[0] for i in range(h[9])]
elf={"class_bits":64,"machine":h[1],"type":h[0],"PT_INTERP_present":3 in types}
units=(p/"units.log").read_text(); assert "15 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out" in units
outcomes=json.loads((p/"outcomes.json").read_text()); assert outcomes=={"build":0,"units":0,"clippy":0}
a=p.with_suffix(".tar.gz"); files=sorted(p.iterdir()); assert len(files)==19
if not a.exists():
 with tarfile.open(a,"x:gz") as t:
  for f in files:
   assert f.is_file() and not f.is_symlink(); t.add(f,arcname=f.name,recursive=False)
packed=a.read_bytes()
with tarfile.open(a,"r:gz") as t:
 members=t.getmembers(); assert len(members)==19
 for m in members:
  assert m.isfile() and pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name).name==m.name
  assert t.extractfile(m).read()==(p/m.name).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"key":"caps-musl-v1","records":str(p),"archive":str(a),"bytes":len(packed),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(packed).hexdigest(),"members":19,"outcomes":outcomes,"units":units,"binary":binary,"elf":elf,"source_files_verified":verified,"Cargo_lock":"cargo-regenerated exact dependency lock retained in original records; initial input lock separately retained","production_prefix_verified":d,"base64":base64.b64encode(packed).decode()}))
'
